benchmark_name: Unseen Med-HALT Reasoning Fake Stress Test
source_policy: Only Med-HALT Reasoning Fake question groups excluded from the controlled Qwen training set were eligible.
leakage_control: Every Fake question group used during Qwen training was removed before this fixed stress-test subset was selected.
prompt_policy: The exact controlled-training prompt structure was reused; only the question, evidence, and candidate answer content changed.
